semiconductor_relevance: High — Fastgate provides specialized manufacturing equipment and components essential for semiconductor production processes.
summary: Fastgate is an import/export trading company that offers high-end semiconductor manufacturing equipment and components, focusing on process performance improvement and cost reduction. They represent various manufacturers, providing advanced solutions like precision flow control valves and ultrasonic flowmeters, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Inline solvent heaters for semiconductor processes
Ultrasonic flowmeters for precise flow measurement
Precision flow control valves with high turndown ratios
Bubble separators for chemical supply processes

regional_presence.Korea: Fastgate has become a new distributor for Tem'tec Co., Ltd, a Korean manufacturer of heat exchangers.
